desired.details: a metric glob that matches nothing

data.description: desired.v2's standard schema (spec/profiles/desired/v2.md, sections 2.10 and 3; core section 10, point 1). A target's contract lists this file, or a copy whose JCS bytes are equal, in [schemas] packed, and types its report resource packed:Report. The type is the profile's by this artifact's id, never by its name alone.

Report.description: What one target did with its author's document, and what is in force: a packed record of 3 to 27 bytes.

fields.description: What is in force: the target's baseline, a document it acted on, or a change its own operation made since.
fields.name: source

fields.description: How the last act ended, which an adoption keeps. not_acted: no act yet in this process.
fields.name: outcome

fields.description: True when the observed version was read from an archive and its author has not confirmed it.
fields.name: last_known

fields.description: The version wholly in force: none, the observed version, or another, which the four in_force fields then name.
fields.name: in_force

fields.description: The run of the version last acted on or adopted, when it is a 16-bit run.
fields.name: observed_run16

fields.description: The same, when it is a 32-bit run. A version has one run, of one width.
fields.name: observed_run32

fields.description: The seq of the version last acted on or adopted.
fields.name: observed_seq

fields.description: The observed document's own revision, where its type carries one.
fields.name: revision

fields.description: With in_force other: the run of the version in force, when it is a 16-bit run.
fields.name: in_force_run16

fields.description: With in_force other: the same, when it is a 32-bit run.
fields.name: in_force_run32

fields.description: With in_force other: the seq of the version in force.
fields.name: in_force_seq

fields.description: With in_force other: the revision of the document in force, where its type carries one.
fields.name: in_force_revision

fields.description: With refused or failed: why. The escape is a code of the document type's own.
fields.name: code

fields.description: Where in the document: an index into the report resource's desired.pointers. 0 is the document itself.
fields.name: pointer

fields.description: A line for a person: an index into the report resource's desired.details.
fields.name: detail

data.$comment: ZenSight types shared by several contracts: zs.thresholds.v1 and zs.desired.v1 must agree on ThresholdsConfig, so both list this file unchanged (Gap G12). Faithful to zensight-common/src/threshold.rs, comparison.rs, alert.rs (AlertSeverity) and desired.rs (AppliedConfig).

Ack.description: A write landed. v1 declared Ack without a schema ('ad-hoc JSON on the wire', zensight-common/src/schema.rs:225). In zk2 success is a value reply and failure a reply_err (O3), so nothing but an optional note remains.

AppliedConfig.description: What is actually in force for one reconcilable topic, and why (desired.v1's observed revision: desired_timestamp).

desired_timestamp.description: HLC timestamp of the applied desired sample (source = desired only).

effective_json.description: The document in force, JSON-encoded as a string. Its real type is the topic's.

topic.description: Repeats the key's {topic} (migration debt; tcgui gap 1).

ComparisonOp.description: Serialized in PascalCase (no serde rename); default GreaterThan.

timestamp.description: The rejected sample's HLC timestamp, when it carried one.

clear.description: Value hysteresis, on the quiet side of value.

labels.description: Label globs, all of which must match. v1 proxies matched `source` here; a device service no longer needs to.

metric.description: Glob over the resource path the service publishes (`if/*/in_errors.rate`). Under zk2 the paths change (the device leaves for the service name, rest families move under metrics/), so v1 rule sets need rewriting (migration debt).

name.description: Stable identity; becomes the alarm rule `threshold:<name>`.

ThresholdsConfig.description: The whole rule set one service evaluates, set wholesale (#928, #931). Every field is serde-defaulted.
